integrity_notes: An all-size proof is accompanied by an independent finite exact enumeration for sizes four through ten; source-based priority assessment is not an exhaustive originality guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Complete strict preference lists, common ascending-label order, exactly one adjacent transposition in one list, even number of at least four participants; sampling is uniform across participant and swap position. Other perturbation models are not established.
title: A single adjacent inversion has a sharp stability threshold near a common roommate ranking
